verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a probe showing a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at grafana.com/api/openapi.json. That is a building block someone could load into an external explorer, not a documented interactive API reference with runnable examples. Nothing in the pack shows a try-it console, an embedded API explorer, or executable sample requests, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
